info.title: ESG Backend API - Admin Routes
info.description: API for ESG Assessment Platform - Admin and Super Admin endpoints for authentication and administration

tags.name: admin-auth
tags.description: Admin and Super Admin authentication operations

tags.name: settings
tags.description: Settings management (Admin/Super Admin for write operations)

post.description: Authenticate an admin or super admin and receive a JWT token. The system first checks super_admin table, then admin table.

get.description: Retrieve the currently authenticated admin or super admin's information
Retrieve a paginated list of all admins. **Super Admin only.**

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return (id, username, email, first_name, last_name, is_active, created_by, created_at, updated_at)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field (prefix with - for descending). Allowed: username, email, first_name, last_name, is_active, created_at, updated_at

post.description: Create a new admin account. **Super Admin only.** The created_by field is automatically set to the current super admin.

get.description: Retrieve a specific admin by their UUID. **Super Admin only.**

patch.description: Update an existing admin's information. **Super Admin only.** Password will be hashed automatically if provided.

delete.description: Soft delete an admin account. **Super Admin only.**

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all users. **Admin/Super Admin only.**

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return (id, name, surname, position, website_url, organization_name, organisation_phone_number, organisation_email, phone_number, address, postal_code, city, state, country, description, tax_number, linkedin, facebook, twitter, logo_url, video_url, email, next_allowed_assessment_date, created_at, updated_at)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field (prefix with - for descending). Allowed: name, surname, position, website_url, organization_name, organisation_phone_number, organisation_email, phone_number, address, postal_code, city, state, country, description, tax_number, linkedin, facebook, twitter, logo_url, video_url, email, next_allowed_assessment_date, created_at, updated_at

post.description: Create a new user account. **Admin/Super Admin only.**

get.description: Retrieve a specific user by their UUID. **Admin/Super Admin only.**

patch.description: Update an existing user's information. **Admin/Super Admin only.** Admins can set next_allowed_assessment_date.

delete.description: Soft delete a user account. **Admin/Super Admin only.**

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all settings. Requires authentication.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return (id, key, value, created_at, updated_at)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field (prefix with - for descending). Allowed: key, created_at, updated_at

post.description: Create a new setting. **Admin/Super Admin only.**

errors.title: Bad Request
errors.detail: Key already exists. Key must be unique

get.description: Retrieve a specific setting by its UUID.

patch.description: Update an existing setting. **Admin/Super Admin only.**

delete.description: Delete a setting by ID. **Admin/Super Admin only.**

get.description: Retrieve a specific setting by its unique key.

patch.description: Update an existing setting by its key. **Admin/Super Admin only.**

creator.description: Super admin who created this admin
